title.zh: Kalshi与Coinbase就伊利诺伊州体育事件合约限制获得部分联邦禁令
title.en: 美国联邦法院初步裁定Kalshi体育事件合约或属互换

current_state.zh: Kalshi and Coinbase secured a partial federal injunction against Illinois, blocking part of the state's effort to restrict their prediction-market and event-contract offerings.
current_state.en: Kalshi and Coinbase secured a partial federal injunction against Illinois, blocking part of the state's effort to restrict their prediction-market and event-contract offerings.

updates.title_zh: 美国联邦法院初步裁定Kalshi体育事件合约或属互换
updates.title_en: 美国联邦法院初步裁定Kalshi体育事件合约或属互换
updates.what_changed_zh: A US federal court in Illinois partially granted a preliminary injunction blocking Illinois from imposing sports-betting licensing and criminal penalties on Kalshi's sports event contracts, holding the contracts are likely swaps under the Commodity Exchange Act and thus likely preempted by federal law.
